title: SG-6.1 · Add a listExecutions admin client function
summary: Admin client can list executions and find the one for the current Round
description: Context: game/frontend/src/api/client.ts already has adminRequest, getCurrentRound, approveExecution, retryExecution and the ExecutionInfo type, but nothing calls GET /api/v1/admin/executions. Desired behavior: add listExecutions and a current-Round ExecutionInfo lookup, covered by a unit test with mocked fetch. Why: the admin console needs execution data to show Round progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin token, when listExecutions is called, then GET /api/v1/admin/executions is requested with a Bearer Authorization header and the parsed ExecutionInfo array is returned
Given executions for several rounds, when the current-Round lookup runs, then the ExecutionInfo whose round_id equals the current Round id is returned, or undefined when none matches
Given a mocked fetch, when the unit tests run, then they pass without any network access
